build_rt1_model: build an RT-1 robot transformer model with configurable transformer layers and image tokenization
tokenize_action_vector: tokenize continuous action vectors into discrete action tokens for RT-1 policy prediction
detokenize_action_tokens: detokenize discrete action tokens back into continuous action vectors for robot control
tokenize_image_with_efficientnet: tokenize images into context-aware tokens using EfficientNet with FiLM conditioning
construct_action_attention_mask: construct causal attention masks that mask action tokens for autoregressive action prediction
